items.question: Which single word is used as a farewell before sleep?
items.gloss_en: an expression used when saying goodbye at night or before sleep
items.gloss_zh: 晚安
items.specific_reason: Good night is standard farewell written as two words; goodnight is used as an interjection in some styles but 'single word' enforces one spelling.
items.suggested_fix: Teach default 'good night' for a farewell; reserve goodnight as variant/headword-specific orthography.

items.pos: past tense / past participle of verb (British spelling)
items.question: Complete using British spelling: Last summer, they ___ across Europe.
items.gloss_en: went from one place to another; British spelling of traveled
items.gloss_zh: 旅行了；行进过（travel 的英式过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: British spelling is clear but the blank also permits walked, drove and flew; it does not say the verb travel.
items.suggested_fix: Specify past tense of travel in British spelling.

items.question: Use one ___ of garlic.
items.gloss_en: a segment of garlic or a dried aromatic flower bud used as spice
items.gloss_zh: 一瓣蒜；丁香（香料）
items.specific_reason: Question and noun gloss correctly mean a garlic clove, but source teaching_sense_id explicitly points to verb cleave and pos=v; cannot certify semantic identity.
items.suggested_fix: Map to verified clove noun sense with versioned identity repair.

items.question: What noun means a person occupying a property without permission?
items.gloss_en: a person who occupies land or a building without the owner's permission
items.gloss_zh: 擅自占用土地或房屋的人
items.specific_reason: Definition is appropriate but 'trespasser' is plausible from vague prompt; squatter implies occupying rather than briefly entering.
items.suggested_fix: Specify someone living in or taking possession of an unoccupied building without permission.

items.question:
The knight ___ the dragon.
Use the irregular past tense of slay.
items.gloss_en: killed deliberately or violently; past tense of slay
items.gloss_zh: 杀死；杀害（slay 的过去式）
items.specific_reason: Irregular past tense of slay is explicitly required, dragon scenario natural, answer uniquely slew in the requested inflection.
items.suggested_fix: No content change.

items.question: Which informal verb means to insult or speak disrespectfully about someone?
items.gloss_en: to insult or speak disrespectfully about someone
items.gloss_zh: 贬低；嘲讽（口语）
items.specific_reason: Dis/diss both appear as colloquial spellings; generic clue also fits mock or insult.
items.suggested_fix: Indicate alternate spelling diss is acceptable or request spelling d-i-s explicitly.

items.question: Which prefix means many or more than one?
items.gloss_en: a prefix meaning many or more than one
items.gloss_zh: 多；多个（前缀）
items.specific_reason: Prefix multi- means many, but poly- also means many; generic question does not select one. Bound prefix should be represented with hyphen.
items.suggested_fix: Use example multicolored and ask for its first prefix, represent multi- in instructional text.

items.question: The guide ___ for everyone to stop.
items.gloss_en: gave a signal; British spelling of signaled
items.gloss_zh: 发出了信号（signal 的英式过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Question does not specify British spelling or base verb signal; waved, motioned, gestured and signaled are all viable.
items.suggested_fix: Specify British English past tense of signal.

items.question: Our team was ___ in the final.
items.gloss_en: struck repeatedly or defeated; past participle of beat
items.gloss_zh: 被打败的；被击打的（beat 的过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Our team was beaten in the final is idiomatic; defeated also fits, despite beat past participle learning objective.
items.suggested_fix: Explicitly ask for the past participle of beat.

items.question: The files were ___ to a new server.
items.gloss_en: moved something or someone to another place or position; past form of transfer
items.gloss_zh: 转移了；调动了（transfer 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Files were moved, copied, uploaded or transferred; plain blank does not isolate answer.
items.suggested_fix: Explicitly ask for past participle of transfer.

items.question: She ___ her keys on the floor.
items.gloss_en: fell or caused something to fall; past form of drop
items.gloss_zh: 落下了；使掉落了（drop 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: She dropped her keys is natural, but placed, left or threw are also possible without meaning cue.
items.suggested_fix: Add explicit base verb drop and past tense instruction.

items.question:
They ___ him of his possessions.
Use the regular past tense of strip (deprive of possessions).
items.gloss_en: deprived someone of possessions; past form of strip
items.gloss_zh: 剥夺了（某人的财物或权利）（strip 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Strip someone of possessions is correct idiom and past tense of strip explicitly requested; stripped uniquely matches morphology.
items.suggested_fix: No content change.

items.question: The order was ___ yesterday.
items.gloss_en: sent goods by ship or another transport method; past form of ship
items.gloss_zh: 已发货；已运输（ship 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: The order was shipped yesterday is natural but placed, processed, dispatched and delivered are also grammatical.
items.suggested_fix: Ask for past participle of ship (send goods to customers).

items.question: The telephone ___ twice.
items.gloss_en: made a ringing sound; past tense of ring
items.gloss_zh: 响了；铃响了（ring 的过去式）
items.specific_reason: The telephone rang twice is idiomatic but beeped or buzzed are possible; prompt doesn't specify ring.
items.suggested_fix: Specify irregular past tense of ring.

items.question: Complete: The second exercise is ___ than the first.
items.gloss_en: less difficult than something else; comparative of easy
items.gloss_zh: 更容易的（easy 的比较级）
items.specific_reason: Comparison structure alone permits harder, shorter, longer and many other comparatives.
items.suggested_fix: Specify comparative of easy.

items.question: The children were ___ early.
items.gloss_en: was put to bed or placed in a bed; past form of bed
items.gloss_zh: 安置在床上；使就寝（bed 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Children were bedded early is unusual outside 'bedded down'; put to bed is normally said. Also were fed/washed/etc fit.
items.suggested_fix: Teach 'put to bed early' as natural expression or explicitly require past participle of bed with an idiomatic bedding-down context.

items.question: We ___ online last night.
items.gloss_en: talked informally; past form of chat
items.gloss_zh: 闲聊过（chat 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: We chatted online is natural but met, worked, studied and talked also plausible.
items.suggested_fix: Specify simple past of chat (informal conversation).

items.question: She is ___ her shoes.
items.gloss_en: fastening something with a knot; -ing form of tie
items.gloss_zh: 正在系；打结（tie 的现在分词或动名词）
items.specific_reason: She is tying her shoes is natural, but polishing, cleaning or finding also satisfy blank.
items.suggested_fix: Specify present participle of tie.

items.question:
She ___ each page closely.
Use the past tense of scan (examine closely).
items.gloss_en: examined closely or intently; past form of scan
items.gloss_zh: 仔细查看了；细察了（scan 的过去式或过去分词）
items.specific_reason: Specific sense of scan as examine closely and explicit past tense make scanned a sound answer.
items.suggested_fix: No content change.

items.question: She ___ a horse yesterday.
items.gloss_en: travelled on or controlled a vehicle or animal; past tense of ride
items.gloss_zh: 骑过；乘坐过（ride 的过去式）
items.specific_reason: She rode a horse yesterday is idiomatic but fed, bought, groomed are possible.
items.suggested_fix: Specify irregular past tense of ride.
